decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship central to the firm's enterprise messaging direction, the heavy investment and visible commitment make continuation the course management will defend, even though there is no website evidence for 2020 to 2021.
Email and fax conversion extends the core multichannel business at low marginal cost, so the declining fax market is not yet a reason to abandon a service the firm has invested in.
The feature is cheap to maintain and tied to the established fax service, but its low visibility and the shrinking fax market make quietly folding it into the base offer more plausible over time.

Sandbox threat protection supports security, which the firm names as a key competitive argument, and rising threat levels let any weak results be read as temporary, so commitment and strategic fit favor keeping it.
